originalTitle: Jensen Huang reportedly tells Nvidia staff it’s ‘not true’ Trump got him rehired

content: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang apologized to staff during his first all-hands since returning to the company, while attempting to distance himself from the narrative that the White House and tech leaders helped him get his job back, according to reports from Bloomberg, The New York Times, and The Handbasket’s Marisa Kabas. During the meeting, Huang reportedly called claims that President Donald Trump was directly involved in his reinstatement — an idea publicly promoted by Trump himself — “completely untrue.” He added, “Don’t think for a second politics played a role in the company. We are the most apolitical company,” according to Kabas. Along with attempting to dismiss Trump’s involvement, Huang reportedly said he also didn’t return because he was a “tech bro” who was “above the law” or “above the code of conduct.” He added that, “no story has been more tortured than this one in human history,” Kabas reports. Instead, Huang said the Nvidia board “evaluated the entire situation,” while receiving assurance from the government that he posed no national security threat, according to the NYT. Huang resigned as CEO of Nvidia on November 12th, following reports of affairs with an alleged Chinese spy and two employees, including vice president of healthcare Kimberly Powell. On Monday, Nvidia announced that it had reinstated Huang as CEO, president, and member of the board — a decision the White House said Trump was “totally involved in.” Trump also confirmed that he worked with Vice President JD Vance and other officials to bring Huang back. A swath of tech leaders, including Tesla CEO Elon Musk, Epic Games CEO Tim Sweeney, and former White House AI czar David Sacks, were also in favor of Huang’s return. In a post on Truth Social, Trump said that the government “has no reason to believe” Huang’s return poses a risk to national security, adding that the US attorney general “does not possess evidence” that he engaged in “unlawful conduct.” Nvidia is still facing an investigation over its accounting practices, according to Reuters. The company is also carrying out its own internal investigation surrounding reports that Huang was the target of a Chinese spy plot. Huang is set to testify before Congress on December 1st to answer questions about national security concerns, and Democrats are already planning to press Huang about his return, as well as Trump’s involvement. Even after all this, Huang reportedly said he “doesn’t believe in succession planning.” He also acknowledged that he violated Nvidia’s code of conduct, adding that he is attending therapy daily, Bloomberg reports. “I made some terrible mistakes,” Huang said, according to the NYT. “I was unfaithful to Lori, and I hurt my kids and of course, I hurt all of you.”
chineseTitle: 据报道，黄仁勋告诉英伟达员工，特朗普让他重新受聘“不是真的”

chineseContent: 据彭博社、《纽约时报》和 The Handbasket 的 Marisa Kabas 报道，英伟达首席执行官黄仁勋在回到公司后的第一次全体会议上向员工道歉，同时试图与白宫和科技领导人帮助他重新获得工作的说法保持距离。据报道，在会议期间，黄称有关唐纳德·特朗普总统直接参与他复职的说法——特朗普本人公开宣传的想法——“完全不真实”。他补充说，“不要再认为政治在公司中发挥了作用。我们是最不关心政治的公司，”卡巴斯说。据报道，黄除了试图否认特朗普的参与之外，还表示他没有回来，因为他是一个“高于法律”或“高于行为准则”的“科技兄弟”。卡巴斯报道说，他补充说，“人类历史上没有比这更令人痛苦的故事了”。据《纽约时报》报道，黄仁勋表示，英伟达董事会“评估了整个情况”，同时得到了政府的保证，称他不会对国家安全构成威胁。黄仁勋于 11 月 12 日辞去英伟达首席执行官一职，此前有报道称，黄仁勋与一名涉嫌中国间谍和包括医疗保健副总裁金伯利·鲍威尔 (Kimberly Powell) 在内的两名员工有染。周一，英伟达宣布恢复黄仁勋的首席执行官、总裁和董事会成员职务——白宫称特朗普“完全参与了这一决定”。特朗普还证实，他与副总统万斯和其他官员合作，将黄带回。包括特斯拉首席执行官埃隆·马斯克、Epic Games 首席执行官蒂姆·斯威尼和前白宫人工智能沙皇大卫·萨克斯在内的一大批科技领袖也支持黄仁勋的回归。特朗普在《Truth Social》上发表的一篇文章中表示，政府“没有理由指责”
whyItMatters: 这条信息属于 AI 与科技趋势信号，适合用于观察工具选型、产品机会、开发者关注点和技术路线变化。
